sloka: अद्य रामस्य तद् दृष्ट्वा मया ऽ ऽनीतं रणाच्छिरः ।सुखी भव महाबाहो सीता भवतु दुःखिता ।। ६.६३.३५ ।।
transliteration: adya rāmasya tad dṛṣṭvā mayā ' 'nītaṁ raṇācchiraḥ ।sukhī bhava mahābāho sītā bhavatu duḥkhitā ।। 6.63.35 ।।

translations.english: "O mighty armed King! You see Rama along with his brother being killed by me and Vanaras fleeing away from the forefront of war."
